scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: npm run clean:backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run clean:frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.copy:frontend: shx rm -rf backend/public && shx mkdir -p backend/public && shx cp -r frontend/dist/. backend/public/
scripts.dev: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.format: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c cyan,magenta "npm run format --prefix frontend" "npm run format --prefix backend"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
